title: Empty SDK writes evade the cumulative byte bound

significance.impact: Repeated empty writes behind a blocked pipe can grow the transport queue without consuming the admitted input allowance.
significance.exposure: Uncommitted SDK transport candidate; production interactive approval remains disabled. Only planted peers and zero-model initialization exercised this code.
significance.detectability: Ordinary nonempty roundtrips pass; the empty-write regression observes one queue entry per empty string.
significance.systemic_implication: A bounded transport lifecycle defect; no evidence of a failure outside this transport seam.
significance.recovery: Repair and replay a new bounded observation; retained failed observations remain unchanged.
significance.rationale: Material failure of the new transport's resource or lifecycle contract, contained before production use.

confidence.basis: Source inspection and an intended pre-fix behavioral assertion failure.

evidence.observation: One hundred empty writes create one hundred entries while accepted bytes remain zero.

claim.failure_mode: An unbounded queue accepts b'' even though its byte count is zero.
claim.downstream_consequence: Repeated empty writes behind a blocked pipe can grow the transport queue without consuming the admitted input allowance.

counterevidence.observation: The production interactive approval route remains rejected.

proof_limits: The Git revision is the candidate base; exact candidate and repaired hashes are retained in sdk-transport-review.md.
This transport finding does not itself establish native permission enforcement, installed routing, or hostile same-user isolation.

remediation.description: Make empty writes no-ops and bound payload entries with serialized backpressure and a reserved EOF slot.

evidence.observation: Make empty writes no-ops and bound payload entries with serialized backpressure and a reserved EOF slot.

performed.independence_basis: The separate finding producer identified the defect; parent-executed behavioral checks and the native CLI where applicable supplied independent observable outcomes. The producer also re-reviewed the repaired source.

evidence.observation: The retained pre-repair failure, repaired focused checks, independent source re-review, and 606-pass full source suite discharge this transport-local defect; native approval enforcement remains outside this finding's closure.

performed.negative_control: The empty-write regression rejected the original one-hundred-entry zero-byte queue. Removing the final entry bound in memory was also rejected at the finite-bound assertion in sdk-unbounded-queue-mutation.json.
